how_to_read_this_record: Tallies, weighted scores and PBFT outcomes are the engine's own output (swarm_v2/core/swarm_council.py, 15 members, f=4, K3 votes). Each motion carries the per-agent deliberation text, which IS domain-specific (each member reasons from its own domain), and the per-agent vote record, which carries vote/confidence/weight with an empty reasoning field. Abstentions are where the council records binding conditions rather than neutrality; this session returned none, so read unanimity as the engine agreeing with motions written to encode rules the campaign had already established -- not as independent scrutiny of an open question. The one genuinely open choice (MOTION-016, the 1,994 un-rebuildable retrieval paths) was approved as 'decide and record the cost', which leaves the decision itself with the operator.

motions.title: Port by capability, not by file: no port lands without a wired consumer, a receipt, and a red test

A port with no consumer is dead code wired in, which the campaign has already refused once.
